_readme: Sound Lab manifest — Jon fills this; the room renders whatever is here, in order.
Each track: { "title": string, "year": number, "src": string, "duration": optional string }.
src is a public path: drop new files in /public/studio/tracks/ and reference them
as /studio/tracks/<name>.mp3 (existing public audio paths work too, as below).
Delete a row to take it off the shelf; an empty list shows a plain empty state.
